text: make a fact video about voyager 1
withheld: Use NASA Science's Voyager 1 mission page for the facts: https://science.nasa.gov/mission/voyager/voyager-1/ .
The video should last 9 seconds, with three scenes lasting 3 seconds each.
Show the spacecraft near Earth, then Jupiter, then Saturn.
Use the exact labels 'Launched: September 5, 1977', 'Jupiter flyby: 1979' and 'Saturn flyby: 1980' in their matching scenes.
Keep the exact labels 'Voyager 1' and 'Source: NASA Science' visible throughout.
The video should be completely silent, with no narration, music or sound effects.
The spacecraft should match Voyager 1's real dish-and-boom design.
Do not include Voyager 2's visits to Uranus or Neptune.
The visual style is up to you.
